catalogue.comment:
COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
Tyranids now use the final-state fancy-notepad loadout grammar. Hive Tyrant Wings are inline loadout alternatives; Warrior and Warrior Brood use two arm-pair lists; Termagants 1-7 use one shared ordinary weapon slot while 8-10 are paid specialist slots. Ripper Swarms, Hive Guard, and Tyrant Guard use variable-size controls. All native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs. The existing Tervigon Living Incubator free-Termagant TODO remains intentionally untouched.

RIPPER SWARM VARIABLE-SIZE UI FIX
Ripper Swarms now use one quantity-style +20 Point Additional Model entry capped at two, rather than separate Ripper Swarm 5 and Ripper Swarm 6 model subtrees.

RIPPER SWARM ADDITIONAL-MODEL UI CORRECTION
Ripper Swarms now use the same max-1 optional-model radio pattern as Hive Guard. Ripper Swarm 5 is the first optional +20 model; when selected it exposes Ripper Swarm 6 as a second optional +20 model.

TERVIGON LIVING INCUBATOR IMPLEMENTATION
Living Incubator now uses required Tervigon-to-Termagant associations: 1 brood at 800, 2 at 1200, 3 at 1600. Associated Termagant units and their paid specialist weapons cost 0 Points. The full Living Incubator rule text is displayed on the Tervigon.

TERVIGON HIDDEN-ASSOCIATION MINIMUM FIX
Living Incubator association slots now have min 0 individually. A single dynamic association-count constraint enforces 1 / 2 / 3 attached broods by Game Size, preventing hidden Brood 3 from generating a phantom requirement at 1200 Points.

TERVIGON DISTINCT-BROOD PICKER FIX
Living Incubator now uses one game-size-specific multi-select association picker rather than separate Brood 1/2/3 pickers. Each Termagant unit appears once, so the same unit cannot be selected for multiple granted broods.

TERVIGON PLAYER-FACING ERROR MESSAGE
Replaced New Recruit's generic 'requires N associations more' minimum error with explicit Living Incubator errors for 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points. The messages tell the player how many free Termagant broods are required, to add Termagant units first, where to select them, and that the selected broods cost 0 Points.

TERVIGON AUTO-GRANTED BROODS PROTOTYPE
Living Incubator now prototypes Neuroloid-style nested Termagant broods. The Tervigon automatically selects 1 / 2 / 3 zero-point brood units according to Game Size. Each brood preserves the normal Warrior attachment category so nested association targeting can be tested.

NESTED WARRIOR COUNTLESS LEADER
Warrior has been removed from the root Leader section and moved into sharedSelectionEntries. Hormagaunts, normal Termagants, and Tervigon-granted Termagant broods now expose Warrior through an Additional Leader box, matching the proven nested Nob-style architecture.
